name: eggd_cnv_chr_strip
title: eggd_cnv_chr_strip
summary: Write Ensembl-named (*.nochr.*) copies of CNV text files; strips chr from the chromosome column only

inputSpec.name: sample_id
inputSpec.label: Sample ID (output stem)
inputSpec.help: Sample identifier used as the stem for all output filenames (e.g. SAMPLE123).

inputSpec.name: cnvkit_cnr
inputSpec.label: CNVkit *.cnr
inputSpec.help: CNVkit copy-number ratio TSV produced by eggd_cnvkit. Contains per-bin log2 coverage ratios.

inputSpec.name: cnvkit_cns
inputSpec.label: CNVkit *.cns
inputSpec.help: CNVkit copy-number segments TSV produced by eggd_cnvkit. Contains segmented log2 ratios.

inputSpec.name: cnvkit_call_cns
inputSpec.label: CNVkit *.call.cns
inputSpec.help: CNVkit called copy-number segments TSV produced by eggd_cnvkit. Includes integer CN calls.

inputSpec.name: cnvkit_genemetrics
inputSpec.label: CNVkit *.genemetrics.tsv
inputSpec.help: CNVkit gene-level copy-number metrics TSV produced by eggd_cnvkit. One row per gene.

inputSpec.name: purple_cnv_somatic
inputSpec.label: PURPLE *.purple.cnv.somatic.tsv
inputSpec.help: PURPLE somatic copy-number segments TSV produced by eggd_purple. Contains purity/ploidy-adjusted CN calls.

inputSpec.name: purple_cnv_gene
inputSpec.label: PURPLE *.purple.cnv.gene.tsv
inputSpec.help: PURPLE gene-level copy-number estimates TSV produced by eggd_purple. One row per gene.
